summary: Huadi International Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq bid-price deficiency notice. The company has 180 days, until January 11, 2027, to regain compliance by closing at $1.00+ for ten consecutive days. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine listing-standards notification, not a special situation. Watch for potential reverse stock split to cure the deficiency; no risk-arb angle.
